entries.description: Authored coverage-audit.md (Phase 8.1-8.2 inventory). Identified Gap A (no pipeline-output -> schema-validation E2E gate; manifest-aggregator does not exist) and Gap B (no black-box CLI tests).

Created tests/AccessHarvester.Integration xUnit project (csproj + TestSupport/{RepoPaths,CliInvoker,AccessAvailability}); added to AccessHarvester.sln. CLI exe copied to test bin via ReferenceOutputAssembly=false ProjectReference.

Authored Cli/CliBootstrapTests, CliParseTests, CliGenerateDocsTests — 7 hermetic black-box CLI tests covering --help/no-args/unknown-cmd, parse flag/bare-file/file-not-found, generate-docs against examples/minimal-form.json.

Authored Pipeline/SchemaConformanceTests (3 theory rows: minimal-form, complex-form, northwind-output validate against harvester-schema.v1.0.json) and Pipeline/EndToEndPipelineTests (SkippableFact: drives Pipeline.Default().Run against samples/MiniComplex.accdb, asserts raw/kb/ir tier shape).

dotnet build AccessHarvester.sln: succeeded, 0 errors. dotnet test AccessHarvester.sln: 1530 passed, 2 skipped (pre-existing synthetic-DB skips), 0 failed. Integration: 14/14 passed including the SkippableFact pipeline run.
Routed coverage-vs-target audit via task_type=schema-validation. Model=gemini-pro. Output saved to coverage-audit-routed.md.
Applied 5 fixes to coverage-audit.md per the schema-validation verifier's findings (1 Critical, 2 Major, 2 Minor). All status=fixed.
Routed next-orchestrator recommendation for Session 2. Model=gemini-pro.
